escalation_labels.WINBACK_CAMPAIGN: budget exhausted: fresh invoice + winback nudge
escalation_labels.RE_MANDATE_LINK: mandate dead: send a new mandate registration link
escalation_labels.MANDATE_UPGRADE: above the mandate's cap: request an upgrade or split it
escalation_labels.AFA_PAYMENT_LINK: above the RBI AFA-free cap: customer-present link with AFA
escalation_labels.HUMAN_REVIEW: unclassifiable: a person reads the bank's own text

scenarios.name: As shipped
scenarios.note: Every stopping rule on, ceilings sized above the batch.

scenarios.name: Without the RBI cap rule
scenarios.note: Rule 6 off. Nothing above the cap is recovered anyway -- the breaker catches it at the action boundary and the network would decline it regardless. The cost moves one layer down, into the refusals row.

scenarios.name: Without the dead-mandate check
scenarios.note: Rule 3 off. Costs nothing here, because the pre-flight status call at the action boundary catches the same records without spending an attempt. Deliberate redundancy: the rule is what produces the re-mandate escalation, the boundary check is what survives the world changing after the decision.

scenarios.name: Breaker set to 40 actions
scenarios.note: The batch stops mid-run. Included so the truncation warning is visible rather than described.
scenarios.tripped: max_actions_per_batch: 41 > 40 — unattended batch action ceiling reached
